setup.title: Engine
setup.body: One open-weight model, **Qwen3.8-27B**, served locally with vLLM (bf16, thinking disabled), one instance per H100 on an 8-GPU node. It is the only LLM in the loop: it writes, mutates and repairs programs, and also writes the summaries on this page.

setup.title: Protocol
setup.body: Search: **SCiEL** with 4 parallel workers, **400 evaluations** per run, seed 0 (extra seeds are marked -s1, -s2). Tasks and evaluators come unchanged from **autoresearch-tasks**. *vs literature* compares the raw value of the best program with the reference value recorded for each task.

setup.title: Scheduling
setup.body: A scheduler keeps up to 64 runs going at once on 8 H100s (one vLLM instance per GPU, at most 8 runs each) and starts the next task as soon as one finishes. A finished run within 2% of the literature value gets one *warm start*: a fresh 400-evaluation run seeded with its best program (code only, no scores or statistics). Once every task has run, tasks that have not beaten the literature value get extra seeds. This site is regenerated about every 6 hours.

setup.title: Caveats
setup.body:
- Values come from each task's numerical evaluator and are evidence, not proofs. Floating-point tolerances apply.
- Results marked ✓ were re-checked independently.
- Model-written summaries and notes can be wrong. Check them against the program.
- Runs active on 29 Oct switched between bf16 and FP8 weights mid-run.
